signs.Aries: You may feel that the person you love and cherish the most has cooled off, or perhaps even decided they no longer wish to be with you. Don't take the signs too seriously. Those around you will be encouraged to spend some time alone to consider their direction and future moves. Given time and space, your partner (current or prospective) will come back to you even more in love than ever.
signs.Taurus: Relationships may need some especially careful handling today. If you feel as though you have been wronged, then it may be better to take some time out to think things through. This is the first crucial stage. When you have something to say, speak honestly from your heart. This will clear the air and create the way for a fresh start.
signs.Gemini: You may wish to convey something to your partner (current or prospective) that requires great tact and delicacy, but naturally you may also be feeling apprehensive about doing so. You may feel fearful of speaking your mind, and yet if you can open your heart and reach through these barriers, you will discover that something quite beautiful can happen. Give love a chance.
signs.Cancer: A certain relationship may be brought to a deadlock today. However, this is not really anything to worry about, as long as you take care to communicate any concerns or issues to your partner (current or prospective) in such a way that bridges are created between you, rather than trust being destroyed. In a few days, this rough patch will have cleared, and things will look rosy once more.
signs.Leo: If your partner (current or prospective) seems to be a little distant or frosty today, don't take it too seriously. Today others are likely to temporarily withdraw so that they can quietly mull a few things over. Within a day or two things should have returned to normal, so just allow them some much-needed space.
signs.Virgo: More than a few ego problems are likely to be part of today's bargain if you are don't pay attention to how you phrase certain requests. You could come across to your partner (current or prospective) as being much more tyrannical then you ever intended to be. Perhaps a breakdown in communication lies behind the mistake, but authentic heart-to-heart sharing will quickly bring a resolution.
signs.Libra: It is no good disguising your grief or angst behind a host of ills today instead of telling your partner (current or prospective) what is really on your mind.  You will feel like hiding away, or behind what is set to be a contentious headache. What you really need to do is express certain feelings that you have taken great pains to hide. It is no longer wise to do so.
signs.Scorpio: Life appears cold and calculating today. Friends may seem more distant than usual, and you yourself may also feel like spending time alone. Go with this, especially if you sense the need to think certain things through, or perhaps seek a different perspective on a recent event that may have thrown your equilibrium off balance. This will bring you back to a state of harmony.
signs.Sagittarius: Sometimes it is the difficulties that occur within relationships that later usher in a greater understanding and depth of communication between two people. Right now, many unacknowledged feelings that have been causing unnecessary tension between you and your partner (current or prospective) are likely to surface. If you can work through these with a spirit of trust, then you may find your relationship considerably strengthened.
signs.Capricorn: The course of today's events may have a profoundly positive effect on you. Whereas you may have been running at quite a high pitch recently, you may be forced to slow down and consider where the relationship you are engaged is actually going, and what your motives are for being involved in the first place. Some deep and careful thought on the subject may be of great value.
signs.Aquarius: You can go one of two ways as far as your close relationships are concerned today. You will find yourself feeling less concerned about the needs of your partner (current or prospective). If you choose to ignore them, you may be placing the partnership under a great deal of strain. This will only make things more difficult in the long run. Take some time out for the alternative: to be nice.
signs.Pisces: A much-needed sense of detachment from a certain relationship that has proved fairly troublesome lately is set to wash over you today. You have needed some space to get a few priorities of your own sorted out and clarified. Now take this sense of clarity and use it to make a final decision that will ultimately bring about the best for both of you.
